FRENCH : GQFMDG :: GERMAN : HDSLBM :: ARABIC : ?

• **FRENCH : GQFMDG **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/834a86e7709b6244dc30bc05470831fd0e4f01c32f72bca53d145432b25226bc.png] 

and

 
• **GERMAN : HDSLBM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7f1d9f162146476eefa7fe404245a006d65e52c596b7ad8117b500398ca8054.png]

• **ARABIC : ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c3fcd39c89558363ec313bec6f3ce4f9901d1b51db124d03f977782788fe26a.png]
